problem: The live canonical-shell verifier treated correct per-route NL/EN hrefs inside the shared mobile menu as structural shell drift.
root_cause: Raw component hashing included route-bound language href and aria-current state even though those values are intentionally page-specific while the shell structure remains canonical.
prevention: Canonical component hashes normalize only href and aria-current on data-bg-language-option anchors.
All non-locale navigation links and structural markup remain hash-significant.
Production shell readback must accept route-aware locale state while still detecting genuine header/mobile-menu drift.
